# Taylormade Creative

> Taylormade Creative is a Dallas–Fort Worth (DFW) creative studio led by director and designer Nelson Taylor. It produces cinematic video, professional photography, AI content systems, custom websites, social media content, and live AI/creative workshops — all in-house, all bookable online with real calendar availability and secure Stripe payment.

Key facts (updated 2026-10-07):
- Based in Dallas–Fort Worth, Texas; shoots on location everywhere.
- Led by Nelson Taylor: 14 years of creative direction and graphic design; also shipped a native iOS app to the App Store.
- Camera platform: Sony FX6 (cinema video) and Sony A7RV (stills).
- Clients have included TONI&GUY, Neutrogena, Oribe, Foot Locker, Takis, Goldwell, R+Co, KMS, MYX, Blackgirl Sunscreen, La Supreme Dallas, and Marviano Cosmetics.
- Booking: clients pick a live time slot at https://www.taylormadecreative.net/book/ and pay online; confirmation, shoot-prep, and reminder emails are automatic.
- Digitals sessions (rapid-fire photos for actors/models/creators) are a flat $100, self-booked any day 9am–9pm Central at https://www.taylormadecreative.net/digitals/.
- Corporate team headshots for companies: $125 per person on-site at the client's office anywhere in DFW, or $99 per person at the downtown Dallas studio; 10-person minimum; one retouched headshot per person, back within 5 business days of picks. Add-ons: extra retouched photo $35 each, advanced retouching $25 per photo, background change $15 per photo, rush delivery within 48 hours +25%. Booked by quote (reply within one business day) at https://www.taylormadecreative.net/book/?service=corporate-headshots.
- Custom websites start at $1,200.
- Video production (brand videos, music videos, commercials, event films, corporate talking-head videos, content days, video podcasts) has no flat price: each project is quoted on scope (concept, locations, crew needs, edit complexity), with a reply within one business day.
- Standard terms for quoted projects: 50% deposit locks the date, balance due on shoot day, ~2-week delivery with two rounds of edits, delivered through a private client portal.
- Instant-book sessions need no quote and are self-booked 9am-9pm Central, any day. Headshots $150 (30 min, one look, 3 retouched finals back within 48 hours of your picks) and digitals $100 are paid in full at booking. Senior photos (mini $150: 30 min, 1 look, 3 edited photos; full $350: 1 hour, 2+ looks, 8 edited photos; Downtown Dallas studio or on location anywhere in DFW, same price) are paid in full at booking. Birthday photoshoots have the same two packages: the full $350 shoot is paid in full at booking; the mini $150 shoot takes a $75 deposit, and the other $75 is auto-charged to the same card the day before the shoot.

## Services
- [Video Production](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/video-production/): music videos, brand films, commercials, event films.
- [Corporate Video](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/corporate-video/): talking-head videos for companies (leadership and company messages, training and onboarding, customer testimonials, explainers, recruiting, social clips), shot at your office anywhere in DFW or the downtown Dallas studio; content days (one shoot day at your location, edited into vertical videos plus a stills bank, built to run for a quarter); video podcasts for companies and creators, recorded in the studio and edited into full episodes plus social clips. Talking-head shoots include script help and a teleprompter; videos come captioned in horizontal and vertical versions with usage rights included; raw footage is available for an extra fee; NDAs signed on request. Travels outside DFW (added to the quote). Quoted per project within one business day.
- [Photography](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/photography/): headshots, corporate team headshots, senior photos, birthday photoshoots, branding photoshoots, event photography, product photography, $100 digitals.
- [Headshots](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/headshots/): professional headshots, $150 flat — 30 minutes, one look, 3 retouched finals in 48 hours, self-booked online 9am–9pm daily.
- [Corporate Headshots](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/corporate-headshots/): team headshots for companies, on-site at your office ($125/person) or in the downtown Dallas studio ($99/person), 10-person minimum, one retouched headshot each, editing add-ons from $15. Headshot booths for conferences and company events, quoted per event. Staff who miss the team shoot can be photographed later. Travel outside DFW is added to the quote.
- [Birthday Photoshoots](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/birthday/): Downtown Dallas studio birthday shoots — mini $150 (30 min, 1 look, 3 edited photos) or full $350 (1 hour, 2+ looks, 8 edited photos), self-booked online.
- [Senior Photos](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/senior-photos/): senior photo sessions in the Downtown Dallas studio or on location anywhere in DFW, same price — mini $150 (30 min, 1 look, 3 edited photos) or full $350 (1 hour, 2+ looks, 8 edited photos), paid in full and self-booked online.
- [Digitals](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/digitals/): casting-ready digitals for models, actors, and creators — $100 flat, 30 minutes, bookable online any day 9am–9pm.
- [AI Content & Automation](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/ai-creative/): AI avatars, generated campaigns, automated content systems.
- [Web Design](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/web-design/): landing pages to full business websites, from $1,200.
- [Social Media Content](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/social-media/): monthly reels, carousels, and strategy retainers.
- [Live Workshops & Training](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/workshops/): hands-on AI and creative training for teams and organizations.
- [Studio Rental — Jenel Studios](https://studio.taylormadecreative.net/): Taylormade Creative's rental space now operates as Jenel Studios (Instagram @jenelstudios) — downtown Dallas natural-light studio, $60/hr weekdays, $75/hr weekends, 4-hour and 8-hour blocks, lighting add-ons, no cameras on site.

## Booking
- [Book a shoot](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/book/): live calendar, online payment, instant confirmation.
- [Prices](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/pricing/): every posted price in one place, plus which work is quoted per project.
- [FAQs](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/faqs/): turnaround, deposits, travel, delivery.

## Guides
- [What headshots cost in Dallas (2026)](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/headshots/cost/): a standard Dallas studio headshot session typically runs $150–$450 (Photography Shark, May 2026); Taylormade Creative's is $150 flat.
- [What it costs to rent a photo studio in Dallas (2026)](https://studio.taylormadecreative.net/studio-rental-cost/): Dallas photo studios average about $90/hr (Peerspace) to $129/hr (Tagvenue); Jenel Studios is $60/hr weekdays, $75/hr weekends.
